violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Hold if Unable to Sit (26 TAC §747.2319(1))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Hold if Unable to Sit
violation_type.typical_finding: The 6 months old infant was observed being fed on the bouncer instead of being held on during feeding time.    This was corrected during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: The 6 months old infant was observed being fed on the bouncer instead of being held on during feeding time.    This was corrected during the inspection.
A 4 month old infant was placed in a car seat to eat their bottle.
The primary caregiver corrected during the inspection by picking up an infant and feeding one at a time.

Two infants, that were not able to sit unassisted, were observed to be fed in bouncer seats. They were not being held by the caregiver as required. This was observed through video obtained during the course of the investigation.
